name: vLLM#50881: MiniMax-M3 fp8 KV cache garbage under CUDA graphs on SM80
notes: MiniMax-M3 with fp8 KV cache on A100/A800 (SM80) generates garbage under CUDA graphs. Root cause: _insert_kv uses plain Python advanced-index scatter, not graph-safe. bf16 path uses fused CUDA op (graph-safe). Fix: decorate with @eager_break_during_capture. Demonstrates KV cache corruption with CUDA graphs.
